detail.sourceFact: DirectorInspector.tsx:1621 -- the tooltip's className contains pointer-events-none, and the source comment records that the site treats it as a hover layer
detail.mechanism: elementsFromPoint skips pointer-events:none elements entirely, so the overlay is at index -1 in every stack and 'what is above it' degenerates to 'whatever else was at that point'
detail.priorWork: 639, 641 and 646 all record elementsFromPoint as blind on pointer-events:none.  None of them drew the consequence: an instrument built on it does not fail, it answers.
